import math

def fetch_products_for_query(q, page_limit=20):
    all_items=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        res = apis.amazon.search_products(query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('query',q,'page',page_index,'len',len(res) if isinstance(res,list) else res)
        if not res:
            break
        all_items.extend(res)
        if len(res) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return all_items

queries=["Osprey Ariel AG 65 Pack","Osprey Atmos AG 65 Pack"]
results={}
for q in queries:
    items=fetch_products_for_query(q, page_limit=20)
    results[q]=items
    prices=sorted([(it.get('price'), it.get('product_id'), it.get('name')) for it in items], key=lambda x:x[0])
    print('total for',q,':',len(items))
    print('cheapest 5 for',q,':')
    for p in prices[:5]:
        print(p)

# Choose cheapest among all items, but prefer exact name containment
chosen={}
for q,items in results.items():
    # prefer items whose name contains q without extra tokens? We'll just match key tokens.
    tokens=[t.lower() for t in q.split() if t.lower() not in ['pack']]
    def score(it):
        name=(it.get('name') or '').lower()
        return sum(1 for t in tokens if t in name)
    # take items with highest score (max match), then min price
    scored=[(score(it), it.get('price'), it.get('product_id'), it.get('name')) for it in items]
    if not scored:
        chosen[q]=None
        continue
    max_score=max(s for s,_,_,_ in scored)
    candidates=[t for t in scored if t[0]==max_score]
    candidates_sorted=sorted(candidates, key=lambda x:x[1])
    best=candidates_sorted[0]
    chosen[q]=best

print('chosen candidates:',chosen)
